lt.line: Ninevės gyventojai stos teisme drauge su šia karta ir ją pasmerks, nes jie atsivertė, išgirdę Jonos pamokslus, o štai čia daugiau, negu Jona“.

en.event: Monday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: At the judgment the men of Nineveh will arise with this generation and condemn it, because at the preaching of Jonah they repented, and there is something greater than Jonah here.
